# Deliverable G: Video-Generation Prompts

One self-contained prompt per shot (278 prompts). Each prompt restates the style, the full design of every character on screen with their **current** damage state, the environment, action, camera, lighting, effects, sound direction, dialogue, continuity with the neighbouring shots, and negative constraints. No prompt relies on a model remembering an earlier clip.

Machine-readable copy: [`output/edit/prompts.jsonl`](../../output/edit/prompts.jsonl).

## How to use

1. Generate each shot at its exact duration (or the model's nearest supported length, then trim to the frame count in the prompt header). Generate 3-4 takes per shot.
2. Lock a reference image per character from the turnaround sheets (Deliverable D) and pass it as an image/character reference wherever the model supports it; the text design block is the fallback, never the only control.
3. For shots longer than the model's limit, split at a motivated point (a cut on action or a camera move) and generate the second half from the last frame of the first (image-to-video) with the same prompt.
4. Do not ask the model for dialogue audio or music; sound is built in post (Deliverable H).
5. Review every take against the QC checklist (Deliverable I) before it goes into the cut.

**Rights note.** These characters belong to Marvel/Disney and DC/Warner Bros. Discovery. Many hosted video models refuse named copyrighted characters; this package is a fan-production concept and any public release needs licensing.
